name: cursed wiki how-to
content_styles: Write like a wikiHow article about the topic. A title, a 'things you'll need' list, numbered steps, a 'tips' section, and a 'warnings' section. Voice is earnest, instructional, and completely wrong.

Write like a wikiHow article written by someone who has never done the thing. A title, a 'things you'll need' list, numbered steps that make no sense, and a 'community Q&A'. Voice is confident and clueless.

Write like a wikiHow article that has been vandalized. A title, a 'things you'll need' list, numbered steps with absurd insertions, and a 'warnings' section. Voice is instructional and increasingly unhinged.
layouts: Build a wikiHow article: a title header, a 'things you'll need' list, numbered steps, a 'tips' section, and a 'warnings' section. One continuous article.
Build a wikiHow article: a title header, a 'things you'll need' list, numbered steps, a 'community Q&A', and a 'warnings' section. One continuous article.
Build a vandalized wikiHow: a title header, a 'things you'll need' list, numbered steps with absurd insertions, and a 'warnings' section. One continuous article.
themes: wikiHow look: white background, green accents, a clean sans-serif, and a step-by-step feel. Unified and instructional.
Cursed wikiHow look: white background, green accents, slightly off-kilter headings, and a clean sans-serif. Unified and unsettling.
Vandalized look: white background, green accents, red insertions, and a clean sans-serif. Unified and chaotic.
